configurePresets.name: windows-release
configurePresets.description: The canonical Windows build tree (build/windows-release). Compiler is whatever cmake finds on PATH (cmake 4.x auto-detects the WinLibs UCRT g++ in the current environment); pass -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=... to force clang. Note: the clang invoked for the programs cp3c itself compiles is cp3c's own detection (C:/Program Files/LLVM/bin/clang++.exe), independent of the binary's compiler.

configurePresets.name: windows-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug variant of the canonical Windows tree (build/windows-debug).
